//: A TRIPWIRE, NOT A TARGET. A run covering LESS than this fails prun, because every shard that ran will have passed and nothing else would say so. Raise it when the suite grows; LOWER it in the same commit that removes assertions, so the reduction is a decision on the record rather than a number that quietly followed the code down.
//why-recorded: Deliberately NOT derived from the suite. An expectation computed by the same scan that finds the sections is satisfied by finding none of them — which is how a run that dispatched nothing prints a plausible small green total. The floor has to come from outside the run.
//measured-by: python3 test/prun.py — the distinct count it prints, and the section group count.
//machine-dependence: THE FLOOR IS WHAT A FRESH CLONE COVERS, not what this checkout does. Two assertions in 'every configured trigger command actually exists' are derived from .game_loop/triggers.json, which is GITIGNORED — a clone legitimately has none, and that section skips honestly rather than failing. Measured each time, in a clone, never subtracted: 2160 in a clone of this branch on 2026-08-27 (2718 passed, 0 failed), up from 2137 at ff50e40. MEASURED AFTER THE REBASE and not before it: two lines of work raised this file independently — 2137 there and 2156 here — and neither number describes the tree that results from both. Taking either would have been a floor for a suite nobody has. Recording 2034 once made every consumer's run report SUITE FLOOR BREACHED for a documented skip, which is the one thing a tripwire must never do: cry loss where nothing was lost. A floor above the minimum any legitimate checkout reaches is not a tripwire, it is a false alarm with a number on it. RAISED 2160 -> 2169 on 2026-08-27, measured in a fresh `git clone` of 4d23fce (3366 passed, 0 failed, 2169 distinct) and not in the working checkout, which reads 2171 because its gitignored triggers.json carries two assertions a clone legitimately skips. The two-line gap was VERIFIED rather than assumed: both numbers come from a real run, neither from subtracting the other, because a floor derived by arithmetic from the tree it is meant to police is the thing the //why-recorded note above refuses. It had sat at +7 for a day and drifted to +11 as assertions landed, and slack in a tripwire is not safety -- it is the number of assertions that can vanish before anything says so. RAISED 2169 -> 2185 on 2026-08-28, same method: a fresh clone of 29952fc, 3398 passed, 0 failed, 2185 distinct, against 2187 in the working checkout — the gap is again EXACTLY the two triggers.json assertions, which is the second independent measurement agreeing and is why the residual is called explained rather than small. Sixteen assertions of slack had accumulated in a day of adding them; a floor is only a tripwire while somebody keeps walking it forward. RAISED 2185 -> 2203 on 2026-09-01, in a clone of 3331307: 3510 passed, 0 FAILED, 2203 distinct, against 2205 in the working checkout. THE FAILURE COUNT IS PART OF THE MEASUREMENT, and this is the second clone run that day — the first reported 2203 distinct WITH THREE FAILURES in it, from a fixture that read a gitignored path and so measured whether the author happened to be pinned. Recording a floor off that run would have calibrated the tripwire against a red tree that happened to print a plausible number. The gap of exactly two is the gitignored triggers.json for the third independent time, which is why it is called explained. RAISED 2203 -> 2215 on 2026-09-01, in a clone of 4af2a74: 3616 passed, 0 FAILED, 2215 distinct, against 2217 in the working checkout. Green clone, per the rule added earlier the same day after an earlier clone printed a plausible 2203 WITH THREE FAILURES in it. The gap of exactly two is the gitignored triggers.json for the FOURTH independent time — at 2169/2171, 2185/2187, 2203/2205 and now 2215/2217. A residual that reproduces across four measurements on four different trees is explained; one that merely looks small is not.
//groups-left-alone: distinct rose and `groups` did not, deliberately. A clone of 48c6585 has 85 section groups against a floor of 81, and tightening a tripwire to the exact count it currently reads is how a floor turns into a target: the next legitimate skip breaches it. 81 is still the number below which a run has demonstrably dispatched too little, which is all this field is for.
